notes: Pursued Whale, printed: '... each opponent creates a 1/1 red Pirate creature token with "This token can't block" and "Creatures you control attack each combat if able."' The Whale enters on your turn; the opponent gets the Pirate. Your 3/3 attacks; the opponent's Opp Bear is told not to block and the Pirate can't block (a spare decision word would make an offered Pirate block), so 3 damage: opponent 20 -> 17. On the opponent's turn the token's controller's creatures must attack: Opp Bear attacks even though the pack declines it, and so does the Pirate; nobody blocks: you 20 - 2 - 1 = 17. The mandate is the token controller's, so it never forced your creatures.
